key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an inline unconditional d.set(nullptr), so it can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard (and the qthread_p.h include) in the qcollator caller; (B) adds an exported QThreadStorageData::clear() that does the check itself, which makes the new public API unconditionally shutdown-safe.
